svg.title: coderprint: 820k lines of code in use, of 1.7M written, all time
svg.desc: 819,888 lines of code in use (498,921 in production, 320,967 in tests), of 1,715,248 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 4,441 commits across all branches, 93 active days, a longest streak of 40 days, a current streak of 5 days, and 6 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 1.6M lines of code. The bars end on 27NOV2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 59%, Lean 16%, Python 15%, TypeScript 5%, JavaScript 3%, Shell 1%, other languages under 1%. Of what was written, 48% is kept.
